title: usedesign route inventory
description: What the code actually registers, as an explicit artifact. Produced by the checked repository — usedesign consumes this, it does not extract routes. See design/route-conformance.md §3.

produced_by.$comment: Required. An inventory whose origin is unknown cannot be judged: a runtime dump and a hand-written list carry very different weight, and check 1 is only as trustworthy as its input.
produced_by.description: How this list was produced — e.g. 'runtime dump, express 4.19' or 'static extraction, scripts/routes.py'.

produced_at.description: Optional. A stale inventory is a silent lie; recording when it was taken lets a checker warn.

routes.$comment: An empty inventory is almost always a failed dump rather than an application with no routes — and silently passing check 1 on a failed dump is the worst outcome the check can produce.

method.description: One entry per method. A handler registered for two methods produces two entries.

path.description: The final path as served, including any mount prefix. Parameter syntax is whatever the framework uses — the checker normalises it.

source.description: Optional, for humans reading a diff. Never used for matching.
